lines.text: Discord Plaza. Channels for everything: events, content, announcements, support. Each one has a purpose.
Hey! I'm Dave. One of the most active builders here. You know what got me going? Presence. Every. Day.
Every day. I reacted to announcements, joined events, helped newcomers. I was not the most technical, but I was present. That counts here.
Dave is right. Reactions in announcements, weekly events, shoutouts - all of it earns Engage Points. Consistency is your strongest asset.
[ ANNOUNCEMENT ACTIVE ] A new update was posted. Reacting to official posts earns points. Small action, powerful habit.
That simple. Someone who does this daily moves faster than someone who does one huge thing once a month.

questions.prompt: What behavior best matches the StandX Growth Path?

options.text: One burst of spam per week

questions.explanation: The system rewards consistent, useful presence. Spam and reward-only behavior are weak signals.

questions.prompt: What can help a member earn a weekly shoutout?
questions.explanation: Shoutouts are for useful contribution: energy, help, signal, and clear value to the community.
